name: ObjectMover-Benchmark
description:
ObjectMover Benchmark
	

This dataset contains the benchmark test data for the CVPR 2025 paper ObjectMover (https://xinyu-andy.github.io/ObjMover/).
ObjMove-A: 200 image sets with objects at two distinct positions per scene and a clean background for reference evaluation.ObjMove-B: 150 image sets from diverse scenes, with complex backgrounds, occlusions, shadows, and manually annotated masks for challenging evaluation.
Results: This contains the results of our method.
evaluation_method: mask AP / IoU for masks and PSNR / SSIM for image fidelity; optionally human_eval for perceptual quality
general_score_metric: mask AP and IoU (for mask prediction) and PSNR/SSIM (for reconstructed image fidelity)
reputation: New CVPR 2025 benchmark; currently limited adoption but likely to attract attention in object-movement and image-editing research communities.
